messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] a very basic question
parts:
Luciano

There are some resources to learn about the Distance software online.  There is a good deal of information to be found at 
http://distancesampling.org/

including some narrated videos at
http://distancesampling.org/videos.html

In addition there is an extensive users manual that ships with the software.  Almost all questions you have specifically regarding the software are addressed in the manual.

With regard to your question about a short-cut data format reducing the redundancy within the data, yes there is an abbreviated form.  Chapter of the Users Guide is entitled "Data in Distance"; after describing the basic data file format (that you have repeated), the chapter goes on to describing "Importing one file per data layer"; intended to address the question you raise.  (In the manual for Distance 7, that discussion begins on page 56 of the users guide).
